about: Scenes of the design-fidelity harness (tools/fidelity/README.md). A scene is a web page state (url, steps on the fixed clock) shot at `frame`; `wubble` names the gallery scene (gallery_smoke.rs SCENES) it is scored against. Each crop is a rect relative to the frame: `web` is a selector measured on the web side; a `direct` crop uses the same rect on wubble's window (geometry parity is the point), a `derived` crop names wubble's own rect (`wubble`: [x, y, w, h], logical px at the web window's size) and is compared top-left aligned at the common size (a wubble-only surface against the design part it derives from); a scene without `wubble` is a web-only reference (kit specimens) shot for the lanes and the owner. Fields added by the ui2a harness: `surface` groups pairs in the report; `gl` picks the WebGL back end (`swiftshader`, the default, or `gpu`, only for pages that draw no WebGL); `gate: false` (scene or crop) makes a pair informational, with `why`; a crop's `mask` lists regions (`web` selector, optionally `pad` px and `toRight` px from the crop's right edge, or `rect` relative to the crop) excluded from SSIM and ΔE; a crop's `wubble: "@<id>"` takes wubble's rect from the element rects file given to score.mjs with --wubble-rects (a derived anatomy pair); `specimens` names the per-control specimen table (specimens.json) expanded into more scenes.
